name: myogenic differentiation 1
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: MYOD1 encodes myoblast determination protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription activator activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of RNA splicing and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to myopathy, congenital, with diaphragmatic defects, respiratory insufficiency, and dysmorphic facies (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Rhabdomyosarcoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports sequence alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
